title: Sign in to FlexiLingo
description: Use your FlexiLingo account email. No password needed.
invalidCode: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.

errors.SEND_OTP_FAILED: Could not send the code. Check the email address and try again.

errors.INVALID_OTP: That code is not valid. Check it and try again.
errors.OTP_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
